name: Geostationary Imager Observation Parser Node
description: A parser and fetch-engine flow node (capabilities: none: every byte comes through the flow's http connector) for imager observations: GOES-East/West ABI NetCDF4, Himawari-9 AHI ISatSS tiles and L2 cloud HDF5 files (byte ranges), and EUMETSAT's view-service imagery (Meteosat-12 FCI, Meteosat-9 SEVIRI IODC, Metop-B/C AVHRR). Each field becomes its world product - the area mean of the native pixels in each 4096 x 2048 cell, holes sampled at the cell centre - at 4096, 2048 and/or 1024 wide, as size-prefixed $WXF records (one per 64-row band) quantized at the instrument's precision with the SDS 1.238 encodings, the reference producer's formulas (Cesium_Weather raw_satellite.py).

sequentialJustification.detail: parse runs one job at a time in a single thread: its state between invocations is the job queue, the active job's bytes (one file, one band or one view frame) and the requests in flight, matched to the connector's responses in order. No worker pool, no threads.

methods.displayName: Fetch and Parse Imager Observations into $WXF World Bands
methods.description: Work jobs + the http connector's responses to this node's requests -> requests, $WXF batches (one field's world product at every width: wxf_meta + wxf_records, one batch per invocation), notices and status. One job is fetched at a time: GOES ABI NetCDF4 files whole (byte ranges appended), Himawari AHI ISatSS tiles assembled and L2 cloud HDF5 files by range (header, chunk B-tree, chunks), EUMETSAT view-service WMS blocks with the GFS skin temperature. GOES and Himawari fields are probed first by their landed mark (304: the node holds them; skipped and noticed). The node yields while work remains that needs no response.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-file work job emitted by imager-observation-source (select_files, plan) inside the same flow: kind abi | ahi-tiles | ahi-h5 | view, the satellite's attribution, frame time, widths, object keys and sizes or the view frame, the fields; never persisted.

inputPorts.description: Work jobs (queued; one fetched at a time).

acceptedTypeSets.description: hostcap/http-request response, one per job: an aligned-binary $HRB raw-body-v1 frame (status plus verbatim NetCDF4 body) or the legacy JSON {status,headers,bodyB64} lane.

wildcardJustification.detail: hostcap/http-request response frame ($HRB raw-body-v1, or legacy {status,headers,bodyB64}) consumed inside this flow; its shape is defined by that generic connector, not by SDS.

inputPorts.description: hostcap/http-request responses to this node's own requests, in request order.

wildcardJustification.detail: Request descriptor for the generic http connector node inside this flow (byte ranges of the job's files, landed-mark probes, WMS GetMap blocks, the GFS skin-temperature message); its shape is defined by that connector, not by SDS.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta for the $WXF batch (schema/provider/source/batch/reconcile/licence/provenance).

wildcardJustification.detail: storage.ingest_with_source meta (schema, provider/source/url/batch attribution, reconcile mode, licence and citation, provenance) consumed by hostcap/storage-ingest inside this flow.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $WXF FlatBuffer record stream, one record per world band (64 rows) per width per field.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-field notice for imager-observation-source note inside the same flow ({satellite, frame_time_ms, field, state: landed | missing}); never persisted.

outputPorts.description: Landed marks found, view frames missing.

wildcardJustification.detail: Fetch status for the flow egress ({failed}, {missing ... unchanged}, {landed_before ... unchanged}); never persisted.

outputPorts.description: Job failures, missing frames and the node's unchanged notice.
